title: Designated Activities
tips:
・Designated Activities visa is for **activities individually designated by the Minister of Justice**

・Covers **various categories** including Working Holiday, Internships, EPA nurses, etc.

・Check the latest Designated Activities categories at the [Immigration Services Agency](https://www.moj.go.jp/isa/)

・**Different conditions and required documents** are set according to each designated activity

・Activity period and work eligibility vary by each Designated Activities category
